bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using a novel FlipEval strategy that horizontally flips images to create paired visual questions, testing whether models rely on real-world statistical priors (e.g., drivers usually sitting on the left side of a car) rather than performing true 3D spatial reasoning.

Using CircularEval to feed the same multiple-choice question to the model multiple times with different permutations of the answer choices, ensuring the model's prediction is consistent and not influenced by the position of the option.
